To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
grit requires perseverance and a strong passion for a long-term goal, and that these two components together positively predict performance.

(1) the effect of grit on performance is moderated by passion, (2) the combination of grit and passion predicts performance, and (3) grit and passion attainment predict performance in part by increasing individuals' immersion in the performance domain.
grit, defined as perseverance and passion, is an important predictor of performance, and that grit is a better predictor when passion is high than when passion is low.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between perseverance and passion and their effects on performance.
the role that perseverance and passion play in performance, and how these two constructs interact to predict performance.
the role that passion plays when assessing the predictive power of grit.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
grit requires perseverance and the attainment of passion to positively predict long-term goal achievement.
the present research provides evidence that the combination of persistence and passion predicts performance.
grit requires perseverance and a strong feeling toward the performance domain in order to predict performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
passion is the fuel that drives perseverance to produce performance.
passion is the key to grit's power.
grit is a powerful predictor of performance but only when it is combined with passion attainment.

passion and perseverance are necessary for grit to positively predict performance.
grit, defined as a combination of perseverance and the attainment of passion for the domain, can predict performance.
